result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: the bottom navigation indicates the wrong active section, and inactive navigation labels have weak contrast.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted in green even though the screen is clearly the Home restaurant feed. This makes the current navigation state inconsistent with the displayed page.
issues.suggestion: Highlight Home as the active tab and render Profile in the inactive style.

issues.description: Inactive bottom-navigation icons and labels use a very light gray on white, making them harder to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Darken the inactive navigation color to meet WCAG contrast guidance while keeping it visually secondary to the active tab.
